audience: WHOOP members and coaches who want to look at recovery, sleep and training data

useCases.title: Review recovery scores over a period
useCases.text: The AI lists recoveries in a time window with recovery %, resting heart rate, HRV, SpO2 and skin temperature. It shows the average and the best and worst days.

useCases.title: Check how you slept
useCases.text: The AI lists sleep activities with the sleep-stage summary, sleep needed, respiratory rate and sleep performance %. It compares nights.

useCases.title: List recent workouts with strain
useCases.text: The AI lists workouts with sport, strain, average and max heart rate, distance and time in each heart-rate zone.

useCases.title: See day strain and energy burned
useCases.text: The AI lists physiological cycles (WHOOP days) with day strain, kilojoules burned and average and max heart rate.

useCases.title: Read your body measurements
useCases.text: The AI reads height, weight and max heart rate on file, with the basic profile.
